department: Faculty of Engineering — Department of Electronic Engineering

gre_general.value: GRE General Test is highly recommended (but not compulsory) by the Division Head for non-Hong Kong university graduates.
gre_general.quote: For non-Hong Kong university graduates, Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test is highly recommended by the Division Head

also.quote: GRE is highly recommended, but not compulsory.

deadline.value: Main Round application deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 (applicants seeking early December interview consideration are encouraged to submit by November 2, 2026; Clearing Round: March 31, 2027).
deadline.quote: The main round admission will close on 1 December 2026.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology (none in this field).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to contact professors in their research interest area before submitting an application.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are advised to contact the professors that fall into your research interest first before you submit the application.

funding.value: Subject to satisfactory academic performance and research progress, postgraduate studentships (HK$19,100 - HK$19,660/month in FAQ; HK$229,200/yr in GS schedule) are provided throughout the normative period.
funding.quote: Subject to satisfactory academic performance and research progress, postgraduate studentships will be provided to students throughout their normative period.

also.quote: Annual studentship for 2026-27 is HK$229,200 (approx. US$29,400). Payable during the normative period of study.

entry_route.value: Eligible to apply for PhD studies with a bachelor's degree even without holding a research-based master's degree, or with a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are eligible to apply for PhD studies even without holding a research-based master's degree.

notes: Department of Electronic Engineering (EE) highlights a November 2, 2026 priority target for early December interviews alongside the December 1, 2026 Main Round deadline. Studentship continuation requires passing the qualifying/screening test within 9 months.
